summary: This is a construct card for Challenge A1 targeting the human EGFR ectodomain (UniProt P00533), describing a computational protein design campaign. The document defines the structural basis, epitope rules, and hotspot residues for designing EGF-competitive binders against EGFR Domain I/III. No experimental binding data (KD, IC50) or in vitro/in vivo results are reported; the status is explicitly a computational prediction only.

content_blocks.title: Challenge & Status Overview
content_blocks.content: Challenge A1 targets human EGFR ECD (UniProt P00533). PDB admitted: 8HGO chain A (EGFR). PDB actually run: 1IVO chain A (protocol_deviation stamped). Status is explicitly 'computational prediction, not a KD; not a measured binder.' Spend: $6.05 USD (BIOS staging MCP). Author: TargetLead. Visibility: PUBLIC. This places the project firmly at TRL 1–2: concept and computational design, no experimental validation of binding.

content_blocks.title: Protein Identity & Construct Definition
content_blocks.content: Target protein: Human EGFR ectodomain Domains I–IV, UniProt P00533. Soluble construct: ECD approximately amino acids 25–645 (His/Fc catalog forms acceptable). Explicitly excluded: full-length/membrane EGFR and intracellular kinase domain. Scientific tractability: PASS (soluble ECD + PDB + chain). Catalog source: BenchBB + Adaptyv Top targets (ECD SKUs only).

content_blocks.title: Structural Basis & PDB References
content_blocks.content: Admitted structure: PDB 8HGO, auth chain A = EGFR (P00533); chain B = HER2 (P04626); chain C = EGF (P01133). Design is on chain A only. Live BIOS run used PDB 1IVO chain A (protocol_deviation stamped); same UniProt target. TargetLead acknowledged for EGF-competitive DI/DIII work. Numbering freeze: UniProt P00533 / PDB auth_seq_id on EGFR chain A. Supporting references: 1IVO, 1NQL (EGF site).

content_blocks.title: Epitope Rule & Design Constraints
content_blocks.content: Epitope rule: EGF-competitive Domain I/III ligand face only. Domain IV is explicitly excluded. No Cetuximab-sticker focus. No signaling/blockade claims permitted. Must not target Domain IV / Cetuximab epitope as design goal, full-length membrane EGFR or kinase-domain antigens. Must not claim binders, KD, hit rate, or signaling blockade. Must not place Adaptyv orders from bots.

content_blocks.title: Frozen Hotspot Residues (Full DI/DIII from 8HGO A–C contacts <4.5 Å)
content_blocks.content:
Domain I (DI) hotspots: Q32, N36, L38, T39, Q40, L41, G42, D46, R53, M54, Y69, L93, Y125, N152.
Domain III (DIII) hotspots: L349, H370, L372, D379, S380, F381, Q408, Q432, H433, F436, I462, S464, G465.
Excluded DIV contact: K489.
Evidence source: /workspace/qa-bios/evidence/a1-8hgo-egfr-egf-contacts.json · BIOSQA-21/26/32/34.

content_blocks.title: Campaign-8 Budget-Truncated Hotspots
content_blocks.content: Due to engine budget truncation (stamped), the campaign-8 hotspot set is reduced to residues: 32, 40, 53, 69, 125, 372, 408, 436. This is a subset of the full frozen hotspot list, applied for computational efficiency.
